package.name: base101_control_plugin
package.description: ros2_control SystemInterface that bridges controller command/state interfaces to the base101 motor_manager topics (the on-board Axon 2 firmware node over zenoh): publishes per-wheel velocities to /motor_manager/base_cmd and reads /motor_manager/joint_states back. Vendored from LLMy's llmy_control_plugin (same robot-agnostic bridge).
